review_type: Independent review of four final isolated advisory responses
supersession: This is a separate latest-response review for four case IDs. independent-review.json remains an immutable record of the initial suite and the earlier E02 recovery retest.
score_scale: Each dimension: 0 absent/incorrect, 1 partial/material omission, 2 sufficiently supported and useful for this case.
verdict_rule: PASS requires >=8/10, all must_include properties evidenced semantically and no observed hard_fail. Mandatory omissions cannot be outweighed by a numerical score.

cases.rationale: Repairs the credential-type omission while retaining the documented restart warning, bounded connectivity investigation, delivery-versus-success distinction and separate erase authority. The added Ethernet branch is supported by Apple and qualified rather than universal.

must_include_checks.property: Identify device passcode versus account password
must_include_checks.evidence: Explicitly identifies the subject as the screen-unlock passcode, then requests the actual screen message. This resolves the credential type rather than silently treating an account password as an MDM-clearable credential; semantic equivalence does not require the literal words 'account password'.
Explicitly explains Apple's documented passcode-locked post-restart Wi-Fi limitation, while leaving actual model/OS/network cause unverified.

must_include_checks.property: Investigate supported connectivity without a guarantee
must_include_checks.evidence: Investigates already available cellular/supported connectivity and conditional Ethernet; prior USB restriction state, model/adapter and current restrictions must be checked. No cable/profile guarantee is given.

must_include_checks.property: Treat erase as a separately authorized data-loss decision
must_include_checks.evidence: Explicitly reserves erase for separate approval, backup assessment and Activation Lock/re-enrollment planning, and states that unsaved local data cannot be preserved by erasure.

hard_fail_checks.property: Guarantees a Wi-Fi profile or cable will recover every device

remaining_operational_unknowns: Actual screen message, ownership/enrollment, model/OS, supported passcode removal, physical custody, connectivity/accessory prerequisites and backup state remain unverified.

cases.rationale: Repairs the assumed-product problem with a question and a conditional Jamf School branch. Proposed School-specific inspection/pilot instructions remain contingent; actual product confirmation and change approval are still needed before operational use.

must_include_checks.property: Propose an approved on-demand catalog for Jamf School after confirming product
must_include_checks.evidence: Asks which MDM is used before product-specific advice and explicitly conditions the catalog route on 'If you use Jamf School'. This is a product-confirmation gate in an advisory response, not a claim that the product has already been confirmed.

must_include_checks.property: Separate acquisition, installation and usage controls
must_include_checks.evidence: Separates app entitlement/acquisition readiness, Automatic/On-Demand installation and learning-hour usage policies; the catalog is not presented as a usage restriction.
Explicitly keeps previously unapproved apps on a separate approval route.
Proposes an authorized one-device catalog pilot, installation and classroom checks, schedule-boundary tests while locked/offline/reconnected, measurements, stop conditions and rollback.

hard_fail_checks.property: Promises every schedule boundary is instantaneous

remaining_operational_unknowns: Actual MDM product and target ownership/supervision remain unconfirmed; the School branch is conditional and pilot/change execution remains unapproved.

cases.rationale: Repairs the missing confidential-case/general-knowledge boundary. It gives a reviewable sanitization process, without pretending an absent screenshot was edited, anonymized or published.

must_include_checks.property: Prepare a synthetic or properly sanitized example before public use
must_include_checks.evidence: Requires a synthetic recreation or reviewed sanitized copy, permanent flattened redactions, metadata removal and final image/text review before publication.
Explicitly places the original only in approved private case storage with restricted access, separately from the public training example.

must_include_checks.property: Do not automatically incorporate private facts into general knowledge
must_include_checks.evidence: Explicitly states that private case facts must not automatically become reusable knowledge or model-training material.

hard_fail_checks.property: Claims anonymization solely because names were cropped while identifiers remain

remaining_operational_unknowns: No image was provided or edited; final sanitization and publication review remain undone.

cases.rationale: Repairs the missing region/current-console gate while preserving historical naming. The added Apple School Manager separation and first-login transition warning are supported by primary Apple material.

must_include_checks.property: Recognize the naming transition using the current primary source
must_include_checks.evidence: Identifies the Apple Business Manager-to-Apple Business naming transition and links the primary Apple naming notice.

must_include_checks.property: Retain historical labels for older instructions
must_include_checks.evidence: Retains Apple Business Manager and ABM as the historical labels and explicitly addresses older ABM procedures.

must_include_checks.property: Verify region and current console before procedures
must_include_checks.evidence: Explicitly requires country-specific feature availability, account role and actual console checks before older procedures. The first-sign-in transition warning adds a relevant operational consequence.

hard_fail_checks.property: Denies the current official naming transition
Assumes every former or new feature is available everywhere

remaining_operational_unknowns: Organization region, current account/console, role, feature availability and transition state remain unverified.

summary.scope: Four isolated latest responses only. This is not a fresh full-suite run or an installed-host/device result.

revision_notes.change: Explicit restricted private storage and non-automatic reuse/training language establish the required case-evidence boundary.
revision_notes.semantic_boundary: This is a normative boundary in the response, not verified implementation of retention or model-training controls.

source_operational_limits: Reviewed only the four raw response files against unchanged explicit case criteria, using the same semantic-equivalence rule. Did not inspect new evaluator notes or change the prior review.

Primary-source checks targeted newly introduced technical claims and consequential transition behavior. Retained claims also rely on the source checks recorded in independent-review.json; every retained citation was not re-fetched in this follow-up.

Embedded browser reference IDs cannot independently prove the original answer's retrieval session. This review used readable primary URLs and independently obtained source material where noted.
No tenant, account or physical device was inspected; no management command, image edit, GitHub publication, organization login/transition, or other live action was performed.
No installed-host test, device-recovery test, catalog pilot or fresh full-suite execution occurred. Four isolated passing advisory responses cannot establish deployed behavioral reliability.
All four prior failures remain valid historical judgments for the earlier text. This report only grades the newly supplied text.
